name: What is the process for deck fascia repair from Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for deck fascia repair from Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our deck fascia repair process begins with a thorough inspection of your deck to assess the extent of the damage and identify any underlying issues. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal outlining the recommended repairs, materials, and estimated cost. Once approved, our team carefully removes the damaged fascia, prepares the surface, and installs new materials, ensuring a secure and aesthetic finish. We conclude with a final inspection to ensure your satisfaction. We always ensure minimal disruption to your property throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves inspection, proposal, removal of damaged fascia, installation of new materials, and a final inspection to ensure quality.
